description: This file contains helper functions for managing channel configuration sections, including enabling/disabling accounts, deleting accounts, and clearing account entry fields within a configuration object.

methods.name: isConfiguredSecretValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty string or a truthy value.

methods.name: setAccountEnabledInConfigSection
methods.description: Enables or disables an account within a specific configuration section, optionally allowing top-level configuration.

methods.name: deleteAccountFromConfigSection
methods.description: Removes an account from a configuration section, optionally clearing specified base fields.

methods.name: clearAccountEntryFields
methods.description: Clears specified fields from an account entry, and optionally marks the fields as cleared if they contain set values.
